## Tickets

### POLISH-001: Thread openProgram to every program that names another

**Status**

Complete on 2026-10-28. `ProgramGuideApp`, `LiveMonitorApp`,
`ChannelsApp`, and `CollectionOrItemSearch` (through Channel Properties, the
Lineup tab, Add shows, Show Properties, and `MemberRows`) take a required
`openProgram` prop wired from `program-contents.tsx`, and the `ChannelWindows`
test harness supplies it. No empty state uses it yet; POLISH-003 does.

**Goal**: The Guide, Live Monitor, My Channels, and the show picker can open
another program the same way TV and Media Library already do (decision 2).

**Scope**: Add an `openProgram` prop to `ProgramGuideApp`, `LiveMonitorApp`,
`ChannelsApp`, and `CollectionOrItemSearch` (through the dialogs that render
it), wired from `program-contents.tsx`. No new context or hook.

**Out of scope**: Changing any empty-state text; POLISH-003 does that.

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Implementation notes**: Keep the prop optional on the picker only if a test
renders it without a host; otherwise required. `programs.ts` already exports
`ProgramId`.

**Verification**: Existing jsdom suites for the four programs still pass with
the prop supplied by their test harnesses; `npm run typecheck`.

**Docs impact**: None.

### POLISH-002: Offer a scan when a root is added and on never-scanned roots

**Status**

Complete on 2026-10-29. The add dialog asks "Scan it now?" once the root is
registered, with Scan focused and Not now beside it, and Scan follows the job
in the existing progress dialog; never-scanned rows raise a Scan button beside
`…`, sharing the row menu's handler. The browser suite's first-run walk
accepts the prompt instead of opening the row menu.

**Goal**: The first run never stalls on finding Scan.

**Scope**: After `POST /media-roots` succeeds, the add dialog asks "Scan it
now?" with Scan as the default and Not now as the other button; Scan starts
the scan and opens the existing progress dialog. Rows whose last scan is null
show a raised **Scan** button in the Actions cell beside `…`; the row-menu
entry stays.

**Out of scope**: Scan scheduling or automatic rescans.

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Implementation notes**: The scan start and progress dialog already exist
behind the row menu (`media-library-app.tsx`, `scan-progress/`); reuse the
same handler. Default focus on Scan, as XP wizards put it on Finish.

**Verification**: jsdom: add a root, see the prompt, accept, see the progress
dialog open against a held `BrowserApi` scan request; a never-scanned root
renders the Scan button, a scanned one does not.

**Docs impact**: `docs/knowledge_base/running-krazitv.md` First Steps says
kraziTV offers the scan.

### POLISH-003: Every empty state carries its next step

**Status**

Complete on 2026-10-29. The Guide and Live Monitor empty states open My
Channels, the show picker's two nothing-yet results open Media Library, My
Channels sends an owner with no channels and an empty catalog (one
`GET /media-items?limit=1` read) to Media Library first, and the Lineup empty
state holds the only **Add shows…** until the first show exists, all through
`openProgram`.

**Goal**: No empty state on the first-run path names a program without a
button that opens it.

**Scope**: The picker's two empty strings end with **Open Media Library**; My
Channels, when `GET /media-items` reports an empty catalog, says "Add your
media in Media Library first, then create a channel." with that button; the
Guide and Live Monitor empty states gain **Open My Channels**; the Lineup
empty state contains **Add shows…**.

**Out of scope**: Reordering desktop icons (decision 3).

**Blocking dependencies**: POLISH-001.

**Implementation notes**: Render the button inside the existing
`.empty-state` paragraph as `screen-message.tsx` does, so all five look alike.
My Channels needs one catalog count read; use the existing media-items
resource with a page size of one rather than a new endpoint.

**Verification**: One jsdom test per empty state clicks the button and sees
`openProgram` called with the right `ProgramId`.

**Docs impact**: None.

### POLISH-004: The TMDB task says where a token comes from

**Status**

Complete on 2026-10-29. The Set up TMDB task says the token is free and
links to Settings, API on themoviedb.org above the token field, and
`TmdbAttribution`'s logo links to TMDB everywhere it appears; both open in a
new tab with `rel="noopener"`. No follow-up.

**Goal**: An owner who follows the tray balloon finishes TMDB setup.

**Scope**: One sentence above the token field: the token is free, it is the
API Read Access Token under Settings, API on themoviedb.org, with a link that
opens in a new tab. The TMDB attribution logo becomes a link to TMDB.

**Out of scope**: Validating the token beyond what the route already does.

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Implementation notes**: External links get `rel="noopener"`. ADR 0013 is
unaffected; only discoverability changes.

**Verification**: jsdom: the view renders the link with the expected href;
`npm run lint`.

**Docs impact**: None.

### POLISH-005: Ask the rebuild question only while a program is airing

**Status**

Complete on 2026-10-29. `useChannelProgramming` polls the channel's now
state and derives `airingProgram`; the Lineup and Rules tabs open the rebuild
question only when it names one, titled "What should happen to <program>?"
with **Let it finish** default, **Stop it now and start the new lineup**, and
the disconnect sentence, in owner words. The Preview tab's explicit Rebuild
is unchanged, and spec 0004's rebuild paragraph records the gate and the
stale-read limit.

**Goal**: Adding the first show is a success, not a quiz (decision 4).

**Scope**: `LineupTab`'s `applied()` (and the Rules tab's equivalent) reads
the channel's `now` state; when `currentItem` is null or is filler, no dialog
opens. When a program is airing the dialog opens, defaults to **Let it
finish**, and is reworded: title "What should happen to <program>?", choices
"Let it finish" and "Stop it now and start the new lineup", and the
disconnect sentence. Amend spec 0004's rebuild paragraph (the one beginning
"Offer the existing administrative choice") to state the gate.

**Out of scope**: The explicit Rebuild on the Preview tab, which stays and
still resets when nothing is airing, as spec 0004 says.

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Implementation notes**: `useChannelProgramming` does not read `now`; add
one `useResource` of the channel's now path there so Lineup and Rules share
it. Do not add a server round trip to the write itself. The read is polled,
so it can be stale at write time; because the write has already applied as
"Let it finish", a stale read only hides the Stop-now offer and never
interrupts, and the Preview tab's Rebuild remains the recovery. Spec 0004 is
`Implemented`; its rebuild paragraph is amended anyway because `GLOSSARY.md`
links it for **Fresh rebuild**, so it still serves as the owning description.

**Verification**: jsdom: add a show with `now` returning no current item and
see no dialog; with an airing program see the dialog with Let it finish
checked; Rules tab likewise. `npm run format` for the spec change.

**Docs impact**: Spec 0004 paragraph amended; GLOSSARY unchanged.

### POLISH-006: One property-sheet footer

**Status**

Complete on 2026-10-29. `SheetFooter` in `controls/sheet-footer/` gives the
General tab and Show Properties OK, Cancel, and Apply, with OK and Apply
enabled only while a field changed; Cancel with changes asks the window's
unsaved-changes question, now the shared `UnsavedChangesDialog`, and
General's OK and Cancel close the window through the `CloseWindow` it lends.

**Goal**: The General tab and the show properties dialog save the way XP
sheets did (decision 8).

**Scope**: A `SheetFooter` in `apps/web/src/controls/` with OK, Cancel, Apply
at the bottom right; Apply and OK enabled only when a field changed; Cancel
and Close discard with the existing unsaved-changes question. The General tab
loses its inline Apply; the show dialog adopts the footer in place of its own
buttons.

**Out of scope**: The collection editor's save bar (decision 8).

**Blocking dependencies**: POLISH-020 if `controls/` is regrouped first;
otherwise place the footer under the folder the regroup chooses for dialogs.

**Implementation notes**: The window already reports dirty state through
`onDirtyChange`; the footer takes `dirty`, `onApply`, `onOk`, `onCancel`.

**Verification**: jsdom: change the name, Apply enables, Apply saves and
disables; OK saves and closes; Cancel with changes asks.

**Docs impact**: Spec 0008 (channel setup UX) gets one line on the footer.

### POLISH-007: Add shows leads with search; Add all confirms

**Status**

Complete on 2026-10-29. Add shows renders the search first and
shows **Add as** above Next only with two or more picks; a lone pick is
always its own show. The collection editor's **Add all (N)** opens a
`WindowDialog` naming N and the collection when N exceeds one page, and adds
directly otherwise.

**Goal**: The first Add shows is about picking, not about wheels; nobody adds
14,000 items by accident.

**Scope**: In `add-shows-dialog.tsx` the search renders first and "Add as"
renders above Next only when two or more items are picked. In
`catalog-picker.tsx`, **Add all (N)** opens a confirmation naming N and the
collection when N exceeds one page; one page or fewer adds directly.

**Out of scope**: Changing what a wheel is.

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Implementation notes**: Use `WindowDialog` for the confirmation, as removal
does.

**Verification**: jsdom: with one pick "Add as" is absent, with two it is
present; Add all over one page shows the confirmation and adds on confirm.

**Docs impact**: None.

### POLISH-008: Chrome and copy one-liners

**Goal**: The small things an owner sees in the first screenshots are right.

**Scope**: Caption `text-overflow: ellipsis` in a `min-width: 0` span;
`.row-badge { margin-left: 6px }`; captions in Trebuchet MS with the Tahoma
fallback; My Channels' action bar sticky at the bottom of the content; a
`small.secondary` hint under the channel number field ("The number viewers
tune to; Plex sorts the guide by it."); TV's Tuning message fades over
`--xp-duration-popup` before unmounting.

**Out of scope**: Any other motion; phone sizes (decision 7).

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Implementation notes**: Keep the fade opacity-only so reduced motion needs
no override. The sticky bar mirrors `.save-bar`.

**Verification**: Existing desktop and TV jsdom suites; a browser-suite
screenshot of a long channel name and of My Channels with nine channels.

**Docs impact**: Spec 0008 (web-admin) gains the motion limits the web role
relies on: transitions under 200 ms, opacity-only under reduced motion, and
none on keyboard-driven or high-frequency actions.
